$comment: Product-intent confirmation records. `intent` is what the program owner must confirm inside the enrolled Associates account; `observation` is what this project saw from outside it. The gate refuses to build if an intent field is filled from an observation field, and refuses to build if an unconfirmed product attribute reaches a page.

fields.intent: confirmation record — intended_asin, official_listing_url, confirmation_date, confirmed_via, confirmed_by
fields.observation: evidence captured 2026-11-20 by following the supplied link
fields.titled_*: text lifted verbatim from the seller's own listing title; a marketing string, not a specification
fields.link_state: observation only: pending-test until a click is seen in Associates Central reports (RUNBOOK R2), then in-account-confirmed; no-link-published for rows with no destination

products.display_name: CHEFMAN 6 Quart Dual Basket Air Fryer Oven

intent.why_blank: Nothing outside the enrolled account can state which listing the owner meant to promote. The observed landing page is evidence of where the link went on one date, not of intent.

observation.page_title_observed: Amazon.com: CHEFMAN 6 Quart Dual Basket Air Fryer Oven with Easy View Windows, Sync Finish, Hi-Fry, Auto Shutoff, 2 Independent 3Qt Nonstick Dishwasher Safe Frying Baskets, Digital Double Air Fryer - Black : Home & Kitchen
observation.breadcrumb_observed: Home & Kitchen › Kitchen & Dining › Small Appliances › Fryers › Air Fryers

compare_points: Two 3-quart baskets is six quarts of volume, not six quarts of one batch — decide whether you actually cook two components at once
The title promises a single finish for both baskets; ask what happens when one basket needs four more minutes
Twin-basket machines are roughly twice the footprint of a single basket: measure the strip of counter and the cabinet height before ordering
View windows and auto shutoff are convenience features, not safety features; do not trade a probe thermometer for either
products.capacity_note: The title states two independent 3Qt baskets: a sum of two halves, not one 6-quart cavity.

products.display_name: Emeril Lagasse 26QT French Door Air Fryer Toaster Oven

intent.why_blank: Same as P-01: intent can only be confirmed in-account.

observation.page_title_observed: Amazon.com: Emeril Lagasse 26QT French Door Multi-Function Air Fryer Toaster Oven | Countertop Convection Cooker, 24 One-Touch Preset Options, Extra Large Interior, Six Cooking Accessories Included : Home & Kitchen
observation.breadcrumb_observed: Home & Kitchen › Kitchen & Dining › Small Appliances › Fryers › Air Fryers

compare_points: Twenty-six quarts of cavity answers a different question from six quarts of basket: whole bird versus weeknight sides
Twenty-four presets is a count, not a capability — find out which two you will use before you pay for the other twenty-two
French doors swing out; check the clearance in front of the machine and the hinge side against your counter run
Included accessories are worth a number: pans, racks and a rotisserie spit decide what you can cook on day one without extra spend
not_verified: whether a given accessory fits a given bird
products.capacity_note: 26QT is cavity volume; rack positions are what decide what fits.

intent.why_blank: Same as P-01: intent can only be confirmed in-account.

observation.page_title_observed: Amazon.com: Chefman Air Fryer 8 Qt | TurboFry® 4-in-1 with 450°F Hi-Fry Option for Crispier Results | Bake, Dehydrate, Frozen | XL Nonstick Dishwasher-Safe Basket | Stainless Steel : Home & Kitchen
observation.breadcrumb_observed: Home & Kitchen › Kitchen & Dining › Small Appliances › Fryers › Air Fryers

compare_points: One tall basket versus two shallow ones changes what fits: a rack of wings needs height, not total quarts
The title names a 450°F high-heat option; ask what it is for and how long the machine holds it
Four functions in the name is a claim about controls, not about results; decide which function replaces an appliance you already own
A dishwasher-safe basket is a cleaning claim from the seller. Check the basket's shape against your rack before you count on it
products.capacity_note: One 8 Qt basket, titled as XL.

products.display_name: CHEF iQ Sense Smart Wireless Meat Thermometer

intent.why_blank: Same as P-01: intent can only be confirmed in-account.

observation.page_title_observed: Amazon.com: CHEF iQ Sense | Smart Wireless Meat Thermometer | 3 Ultra-Thin Probes | WiFi Unlimited Range | 1000°F Heat Safe | 5 Sensors | BBQ, Grill, Oven, Smoker, Air Fryer | Gen3: Home & Kitchen
observation.breadcrumb_observed: Home & Kitchen › Kitchen & Dining › Kitchen Utensils & Gadgets › Thermometers & Timers › Meat

titled_features: BBQ, Grill, Oven, Smoker, Air Fryer
compare_points: Three probes with five sensors is the useful part: one probe can watch thickness and doneness at the same time
WiFi range claims describe a test condition, not a promise about your kitchen: a metal oven door and a foil-lined basket are not an open field
Air fryers were named in the title's use list; the real job is the thickest part of the food, which is where a basket's airflow gives the noisiest readings
Heat-safe ratings cover the probe and lead, not the base unit; check what may stay in a 450°F cavity
not_verified: app store availability and platform support

rules: An `intent.*` field may only be written by someone with access to the enrolled Associates account. An agent may not fill it from `observation.*`.
A `titled_*` string may appear on a page only with the words 'as titled' or a direct link to the listing it came from.
A field in `not_verified` may not appear anywhere in the site's HTML, in any form, including as an estimate.
